title: 02. Tool Calling & MCP: Parallel Tool Calling
summary: Parallel Tool Calling: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
USER: "What's the weather in Paris AND Tokyo? Also find latest AI news."

LLM RESPONSE (all at once):
{
  "tool_calls": [
    {"id": "call_1", "function": {"name": "get_weather", "arguments": '{"city": "Paris"}'}},
    {"id": "call_2", "function": {"name": "get_weather", "arguments": '{"city": "Tokyo"}'}},
    {"id": "call_3", "function": {"name": "web_search",  "arguments": '{"query": "AI news 2025"}'}}
  ]
}

YOUR CODE:
  # Execute ALL THREE in parallel!
  results = await asyncio.gather(
    get_weather(city="Paris"),
    get_weather(city="Tokyo"),
    web_search(query="AI news 2025")
  )

  # Time taken: max(individual times) not sum!
  # Paris weather: 0.3s
  # Tokyo weather: 0.3s  → All finish in 1.5s total
  # Web search:    1.5s      (not 2.1s sequential!)
```
